program_name: Plant Biotechnology for Food and Global Health (PlantBiotech)
campus: Viterbo - Campus Riello, DAFNE (Dipartimento di Scienze Agrarie e Forestali)
academic_requirements: Italian First-cycle (Bachelor's/Laurea) qualification in classes L-2, L-13, L-25 or L-26, or a foreign equivalent (BSc) in the same or related subject area (Biotechnology, Agricultural Sciences), with possible extra coursework if required competences are lacking. Curricular requisite (compulsory on bachelor's transcript): at least 20 CFU/ECTS among Mathematics (MAT/01-09), Physics (FIS/01-07), General Chemistry (CHIM/03), Organic Chemistry (CHIM/06), Genetics (AGR/07, BIO/18), Plant Biology (BIO/04, BIO/15) and Biochemistry (BIO/10); for exams taken abroad, SSD-area matching is determined by the Technical Committee from applicant documentation. Grade Point Average requirement: at least 25/30 on the Italian evaluation scale (official MIUR formula) OR Second Upper Class / grade B+ (CGPA at least 3.4/4, 4.3/5, 6/7, 8.5/10, 17/20 or 105/110). If foreign pre-enrolment applications exceed 200 in a given cycle, additional selection criteria apply: Bachelor's degree in biotechnology or highly similar field, and GPA higher than 95%.
language_requirements: English CEFR B2, evidenced by certificate (not required for candidates from English-speaking countries or with documented education in English/EMI). Accepted certificates/minimum scores: TOEFL > 87; IELTS > 5.5; City and Guilds (PITMAN) IESOL B2 communicator; Cambridge ESOL FCE; Trinity College London ISE II; British Institute ESOL B2. Candidates lacking a certificate take an additional English test as part of the Admission Interview. No Italian language requirement is stated for this fully-English programme.
entry_exam_or_test: Compulsory admission interview (open access, no numero chiuso/TOLC) assessing preparation in: General biology (biological macromolecules, cell structure, prokaryotes vs eukaryotes), Plant biology (autotrophs/heterotrophs, plant cell and tissues, plant organs/systems), and Genetics (genotype-to-phenotype, Mendel's laws and meiosis, mutation types). The same test also applies to students transferring from other MSc courses. Candidates without an English certificate sit an additional English test during the same interview. Booking: foreign-degree candidates first register via the university Contact form, then book the interview via https://forms.gle/GRzcGKgF5Rs31NtBA, uploading degree certificate, passport copy, and chosen interview date; candidates graduated in Italy/Tuscia use the same form with only the date/details required. Interview calendar for AY 2026/2027: international-students-only slots on 2026-01-30, 2026-02-27, 2026-03-27, 2026-04-24; open-to-all-students slots on 2026-05-29, 2026-06-26, 2026-07-31 (additional dates communicated directly to applicants as needed). NOTE: the program's own admissions section states 'The interview will take place after the student arrival in Viterbo' (in-person), which appears to conflict with the DAFNE department's pre-enrolment/interview-calendar page describing the process as conducted via Google Meet (per pre-research); this could not be fully reconciled from primary sources in this pass - see uncertainty_notes.
application_deadline_eu: No fixed programme-specific application deadline is published; admission is rolling via the interview calendar above (open to all students from 2026-05-29). University-wide 2026/2027 enrolment window: opens 2026-08-01; deadline for Bachelor's and Master's-year-2+ students 2026-11-04; deadline for 1st-year Master's students 2026-12-29; extension for Jan/Feb 2027 graduates 2026-02-28. The program page separately references a post-admission enrolment 'deadline November 2nd' with no year stated - this is inconsistent with the confirmed 2026/2027 calendar (Dec 29 for 1st-year Master's) and looks like leftover/unverified text; treat 2026-12-29 as the operative deadline for AY 2026/2027.
application_deadline_non_eu: No fixed programme-specific application deadline; interview-based rolling admission, with international-only interview slots offered earlier in the cycle (Jan-Apr 2026, see entry_exam_or_test). After a positive Admission Committee evaluation, extra-EU candidates must complete pre-enrolment via the Universitaly portal (https://www.universitaly.it/index.php/), which the page notes 'usually opens...in the months of April/May'. University-wide non-EU calendar: onsite enrolment at International Students Desk opens 2026-08-01; consulate visa application cutoff 2026-11-30.
required_documents: Foreign-degree candidates: digital copy (good quality) of university degree certificate(s) including list of exams, grades and credits; digital copy (good quality) of passport; chosen interview date (submitted via https://forms.gle/GRzcGKgF5Rs31NtBA)
Candidates graduated in Italy/Tuscia: same booking form, only need to specify interview date (degree documents on file)
Preliminary step for foreign-degree candidates: registration via the University Contact form (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc7HoIa8ODNSlBjJ7EI4Gu3jwm3RgIzYranddURQEOdTau0Tg/viewform)
Extra-EU candidates (post positive interview result): Universitaly pre-enrolment portal registration

University-wide baseline (for final enrolment, all international students): certified copy of secondary school diploma with Apostille/legalization and certified Italian translation OR CIMEA Statement of Verification; Bachelor's degree (at least 3 years) with same legalization options; Transcript of Records; Declaration of Value (consulate) OR CIMEA Statement of Comparability OR ARDI Statement of Correspondence; Diploma Supplement (can replace Declaration of Value if legalized); English certificate or EMI proof; Admission letter
Proof of financial means for visa: EUR 10,179.85/year (non-EU students)

tuition_or_fees_link.note: ISEEUP income-based fee model; students not declaring ISEEUP pay a flat fee by home-country band (4 bands: EUR 600 / 1,050 / 1,500 / 1,950 per year per Annex 1 country list). Full regulation: https://www.unitus.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/TUITION-FEES-AND-CONTRIBUTIONS-REGULATIONS_2026-2027.pdf ; country bands: https://www.unitus.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/All.1_-Paesi_studenti-internazionali_2026_2027.pdf ; simulator: https://www.unitus.it/en/students/fees-and-contributions/tuition-fee-simulator/

source_quotes.quote: Enrolment in the Plant Biotechnology for Food and Global health (PlantBiotech) master's course is possible for candidates having an Italian First cycle qualification...or a foreign equivalent (BSc) in the same or related subject area...Enrolment is possible if the following requisites are met.

Linguistic requirements: English B2 certificate (not necessary for candidates from English-speaking countries or with documented education in English). In particular: TOEFL > 87; IELTS > 5.5; City and Guilds (PITMAN) > IESOL B2 communicator; Cambridge ESOL > FCE; Trinity College London > ISE II; British Institute > ESOL B2.
The interview will take place after the student arrival in Viterbo.
Calendar of the interviews for the Academic Year 2026/27 - RESERVED TO INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS - January 30th, February 27th, March 27th, April 24th - FOR ALL STUDENTS May 29th, June 26th, July 31th.
For the following steps, the student will be contacted by a tutor that will provide the support to finalize the enrollment through the student platform (deadline November 2nd).

For the additional procedure (pre-enrolment) required for the extra-EU citizens the candidate should access to the Ministry web portal https://www.universitaly.it/index.php/...The Universitaly platform usually opens such procedure in the months of April/May.

uncertainty_notes: 1) UNRESOLVED CONFLICT: the program's own admissions section on the official English page states plainly 'The interview will take place after the student arrival in Viterbo' (implying in-person, on campus), while pre-research on the DAFNE department's pre-enrolment/interview-calendar page indicated a Google Meet online format. Both would be unitus.it primary sources; this pass could not locate a live, distinct DAFNE calendar page to directly re-verify the Google Meet claim (a guessed DAFNE URL returned the generic site shell, not program content), so the conflict is reported rather than resolved. Given the explicit and current (AY 2026/27-labeled) wording on the program's own page, 'in-person after arrival in Viterbo' should be treated as the more authoritative statement, but applicants should confirm directly with the department since online interviews are common practice at UNITUS for other programmes. 2) The 'deadline November 2nd' referenced for post-admission enrolment has no year attached and conflicts with the confirmed 2026/2027 university-wide calendar (1st-year Master's deadline 2026-12-29); likely leftover/unverified text - 2026-12-29 should be treated as operative. 3) The 200-application quota and '95%' GPA threshold apply only to foreign (non-EU/international) pre-enrolment applicants specifically, per the page text, and the '95%' figure is given without specifying which of the listed GPA scales it is measured against - reported verbatim as it appears on the source page. 4) No programme-specific official call/bando PDF exists (open-access + interview process, consistent with baseline); official_call_url points to the program brochure PDF, the closest analog to an official call document found on unitus.it.
